title: Analyte-mediated growth of gold nanoparticles for non-aggregation-based colorimetric detection of manganese(II)
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29932-29939
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02740G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Melisew Tadele Alula, Mildred Lesang Madingwane
Colorimetric method for detection of Mn2+ is developed. Localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) property of gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) is considered for sensing Mn2+. The extinction intensity of AuNPs increases when they interact with Mn2+.
